1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Sistem

Insurans Pekerjaan (Perbekalan) 2021.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2021

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi dua ratus empat puluh lima juta

lima ratus sembilan puluh lima ribu ringgit (RM245,595,000) daripada Kumpulan Wang

Insurans Pekerjaan bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Sistem Insurans Pekerjaan bagi

tahun 2021 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 93,837,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 92,231,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 628,000

Harta tanah, loji dan kelengkapan 24,307,000

JUMLAH 245,595,000

Dibuat 3 Jun 2021

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM ACT 2017

 EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 48(1) of the

Employment Insurance System Act 2017 [Act 800], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employment Insurance System (Supply)

Regulations 2021.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2021

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding two hundred and forty-five million five hundred

and ninety-five thousand ringgit (RM245,595,000) from the Employment Insurance Fund

for the expenditure on administration of the Employment Insurance System for the

year 2021 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purposes Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 93,837,000

Supplies and services 92,231,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 628,000

Other expenditures 34,592,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 24,307,000

TOTAL 245,595,000

Made 3 June 2021

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/28/3; PN(PU2)747/III]

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Minister of Human Resources
